description: Starter Bracino dashboard: tank temps, gateway ambient, pump relay. Record-hygiene reminders: bench traffic shares node_id (distinguish by temp/mode signature); brownout-adjacent sensor glitches are not plant events (issue 019); backstop double-stops are known-benign (issue 016 addendum).

panels.description: Tank-side NTCs from the node telemetry measurement. Sampled every 15 s; plotted values can lag the internal control law by one tick. Legend colors follow boot_session (series stay split per boot; labels dropped from the frame so the legend reads TPO/TPU).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "bracino")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "telemetry" and (r._field == "t_tpo" or r._field == "t_tpu"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.node_id == "1")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: if r._field == "t_tpo" then "TPO" else "TPU" }))
  |> group(columns: ["_field", "boot_session"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field", "boot_session"])
  |> yield(name: "_mean")

panels.title: Tank temps — TPO / TPU (node 1)

panels.description: Pump relay from telemetry samples. X-axis hidden by design — the tank-temps panel above carries the time axis (shared crosshair keeps rows aligned); Grafana has no native 'date only when it changes' tick format, so dates are shown once instead of on every tick. Shaded ON spans smear at coarse zoom; edges come from relay_state in the record.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "bracino")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "telemetry" and r._field == "relay_state")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.node_id == "1")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "Pump relay" }))
  |> group(columns: ["_field", "boot_session"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field", "boot_session"])
  |> yield(name: "_mean")

panels.title: Pump relay (node 1)

panels.description: Gateway-side ambient (boiler room), 30 s cadence. Pre-2026-09-06T14:49Z values of -31.3 are a misranged GW channel, masked by the plotter but visible here.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "bracino")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gw_ambient" and r._field == "t_amb")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "Ambient" }))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
  |> yield(name: "_mean")

panels.title: Ambient — GW (boiler room)
